en.headline: HKTDC Food Expo enters final day at Convention and Exhibition Centre
en.dek: The five-day event and concurrent Beauty & Wellness and Home Delights expos close at 6 p.m. Monday after drawing exhibitors from more than 30 countries and regions.
body: The 36th HKTDC Food Expo reaches its final day on Monday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, with public halls open from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.

Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, the fair has run since 13 August alongside the Beauty & Wellness Expo and Home Delights Expo. More than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions took part across the concurrent events, which also included the Hong Kong International Tea Fair earlier in the week.

Admission to the public halls requires a ticket. Children aged three or below and seniors aged 65 or above enter free of charge. No admission is allowed in the final 45 minutes before closing. Visitors were advised to check the organiser’s channels for the latest ticketing and access arrangements.

zh.headline: 貿發局美食博覽今日最後一天 會展晚上6時閉幕
zh.dek: 一連五日的美食博覽連同美與健生活博覽及家電家居博覽於周一晚上6時結束，逾30個國家及地區展商參與。
body: 第36屆香港貿發局美食博覽今日（周一）進入最後一天，於灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，公眾展廳開放時間為上午10時至晚上6時。
展覽由香港貿易發展局主辦，自8月13日起連同美與健生活博覽及家電家居博覽同步舉行。同期活動亦包括較早前結束的香港國際茶展。五項展覽共吸引來自逾30個國家及地區超過1,850家展商參與。
公眾展廳需購票入場，三歲或以下兒童及65歲或以上長者免費。閉館前45分鐘停止進場。市民可留意主辦機構公布的最新門票及入場安排。
